import pathlib,shutil,os,subprocess,json,re
home=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack');root=home/'public_html'
backup=home/'backup/ontrack-full-2026-11-03'
stage=home/'.ontrack-root-stage-20261103'
source=root/'saas/console'
status=json.loads((backup/'status.json').read_text())
if status.get('status')!='success' or status.get('sqlite_integrity')!='ok':raise RuntimeError('private_full_backup_not_verified')
if stage.exists():raise RuntimeError('staging_already_exists')
if not (source/'_core/FlowAiLive.php').is_file() or not (source/'index.php').is_file():raise RuntimeError('console_source_missing')
shutil.copytree(source,stage,symlinks=True)
mobile=root/'saas/mobile'
if not (mobile/'index.php').is_file():raise RuntimeError('mobile_pilot_missing')
shutil.copytree(mobile,stage/'mobile',symlinks=False)
well=root/'.well-known'
if well.is_dir():shutil.copytree(well,stage/'.well-known',symlinks=True)
(stage/'saas').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(stage/'saas/mobile').symlink_to('../mobile',target_is_directory=True)
(stage/'saas/.htaccess').write_text('Options -Indexes\n')
apache='''Options -Indexes
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^app\\.ontrackegy\\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^saas/console/?(.*)$ /$1 [L,QSA]
RewriteRule ^saas/mobile/(.*)$ /mobile/$1 [L,QSA]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule ^ index.php [L,QSA]
</IfModule>
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
Header always set X-Frame-Options DENY
Header always set Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin
Header always set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
</IfModule>
<FilesMatch "^\\.(?!htaccess).*|\\.(bak|sql|log|sqlite|env|ini)$">
Require all denied
</FilesMatch>
'''
(stage/'.htaccess').write_text(apache)
changes=0
for entry in stage.rglob('*'):
 if not entry.is_file() or entry.is_symlink() or entry.suffix.lower() not in ['.php','.js','.css','.html']:continue
 # Keep Android mobile assets immutable (native OTA is signed).
 if entry.relative_to(stage).parts[0] in ['mobile','saas']:continue
 s=entry.read_text(errors='replace')
 t=s.replace('/saas/console','')
 if entry.relative_to(stage).as_posix()=='_core/Bootstrap.php':
  t=t.replace("$prefix='';","$prefix='/saas/console';")
  t=t.replace("function go(string $path):never {header('Location: '.($path==='/'?'':$path),true,303);exit;}","function go(string $path):never {header('Location: /'.ltrim($path,'/'),true,303);exit;}")
  t=t.replace("'path'=>'',","'path'=>'/',")
 if entry.relative_to(stage).as_posix()=='index.php':
  t=t.replace("setcookie(session_name(),'',time()-3600,'/','',true,true)","setcookie(session_name(),'',time()-3600,'/','',true,true)")
 if t!=s:
  entry.write_text(t)
  changes+=1
# Additional root security: no full SaaS backup or private DB inside webroot.
for directory in stage.rglob('*'):
 if directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink():directory.chmod(0o755)
 elif directory.is_file():directory.chmod(0o644)
php='/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php'

       '_core/FlowAiLive.php','_core/FlowAiJobs.php','api/v1/index.php','device/v1/index.php']
for name in tests:
 p=subprocess.run([php,'-l',str(stage/name)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
 if p.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('php_syntax_'+name)
assert (stage/'assets/js/flow-graph.js').is_file()
assert (stage/'mobile/updates').is_dir()
assert (stage/'saas/mobile').resolve()==(stage/'mobile').resolve()
assert "Location: /'.ltrim" in (stage/'_core/Bootstrap.php').read_text()
assert "$prefix='/saas/console';" in (stage/'_core/Bootstrap.php').read_text()
print(json.dumps({'status':'stage_verified','path':str(stage),'files_tested':len(tests),'url_files_updated':changes,'mobile_compat_symlink':True,'backup_verified':True,'cutover_performed':False},ensure_ascii=False))
